features.badges_desc: Earn badges for achievements (first recipe, 10 recipes...) and track your progress.
features.shopping_list_desc: Generate a shopping list based on your meal plan and send it via email or PDF.
features.pdf_report_desc: Generate weekly or monthly reports on your nutrition with all details.
features.smartwatch_desc: Connect with Apple Health or Google Fit and track progress in real-time.
features.no_ads_desc: Enjoy a clean experience without any distracting ads.
